name: AK22BH - Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR & Electrochemical Sensors, Dial Display
highlights: The AK22B With Its Sensing Upgraded — The central dial face, unchanged, with infrared NDIR CO₂ and an electrochemical formaldehyde cell behind it. Readable from across a lobby and defensible in writing.

Glanceable and Defensible at the Same Time — Public-facing displays usually trade accuracy for legibility. This configuration does not: the dial reads from the far side of a lobby and the sensors behind it are report-grade.
Eight Parameters, Laser Particulates — Full PM1.0 / PM2.5 / PM10 split feeding the AQI band.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four hours to a full charge; 379 g, 21 pcs per carton.
21 Per Carton — 515.5 × 445.5 × 223 mm outer carton, 14.9 kg gross.
